about_the_game:
• Strategy comes to the wrestling arena!

  • Head Wrestle Online is an online oil wrestling game where you defeat your opponent with turn-based tactics.

  • Develop your wrestler, devise your strategy, and make your mark on the mat!

  • Head Wrestle Online is an original PvP game that blends traditional Turkish oil wrestling with modern turn-based strategy mechanics.

  • In every move, sweat, intelligence, and tactics speak!

  • Make moves in turn with your opponent, choose your grip position, enter the balance battle, and gain the upper hand with special moves like “chırpma” or “künde” at the right moment.

  • Every wrestler has unique abilities, statistics, and upgradable features.

  • To pin your opponent to the mat, you need not just muscles but also brains!

  • Are you ready, wrestler?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 (3.1 GHz)
  • Memory: 700 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000 veya DirectX 11 uyumlu, 512 MB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 350 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX uyumlu
  • VR Support: Desteklenmiyor
  • Additional Notes: A constant internet connection is required for multiplayer.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 (3.3 GHz) veya AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
